cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Communication Officer position at Jobat, where you're seeking a proactive communicator for an international automotive company. With my background in digital marketing, SEO and content creation, I'm drawn to the opportunity to shape communication across channels and bring ideas to life in a dynamic, international setting.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I develop a wide range of communication materials—from website content and blog posts to social media updates and newsletters. I manage social media channels, create engaging photo and video content, and coordinate website content to ensure a consistent brand identity. I regularly translate technical information into accessible language, whether for client websites or for internal stakeholders. My work with WordPress, Elementor and various CMS platforms has given me hands-on experience in publishing and maintaining content that resonates with diverse audiences.

Collaboration is central to my approach. I work closely with marketing, sales and operations teams, as well as international colleagues, to align communication efforts and identify opportunities to improve digital presence. For example, I supported the team at Knowledge Experts in building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for major clients like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, where clear communication and coordination were essential. I'm comfortable taking ownership of projects from initial idea to publication, and I thrive on finding creative ways to showcase expertise and solutions.

I'm eager to bring my skills to an international environment where communication plays a key role. I'm confident that my ability to create engaging content, manage channels and collaborate across teams would make a valuable contribution to your client's communication efforts.

Thank you for considering my application. I've attached my CV and would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Kind regards,

Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• Creates a wide range of communication materials, including brochures, presentations, newsletters, product content and social media posts, as part of digital marketing roles.
• Manages social media channels and creates engaging photo and video content, taking ownership from idea to publication.
• Coordinates website content and translates technical information into accessible communication, ensuring consistent brand identity across channels.
• Works closely with marketing, sales, operations and international colleagues, proactively identifying opportunities to improve digital presence.
• Proficient in WordPress, Elementor, Canva and analytics tools (Google Analytics, Search Console), with a technical background in front-end development.
